## Proposal summary

This proposal asks to fund an interview series on #SalmanNeedsAJob, from Polkadot Now which is India's first-ever Polkadot Conference taking place on April 1-2 in Bangalore, India. The series aims to showcase the opportunities offered by the Polkadot ecosystem to the web3 community.

Each video will be labeled as being supported by EdgewareDAO.

Conference link:[ www.polkadotnowindia.com](https://www.polkadotnowindia.com/)

## Background: #SalmanNeedsAJob

#SalmanNeedsAJob is a citizen journalism project exploring the world of work in web3, where I have an extensive portfolio of interviews about various web3 topics. The quality of the work can be attested by the fact that the project has been recently recognized by DAO Drops, an initiative by dOrg and the Ethereum Foundation for their first retroactive public goods funding round. My most recent interview explores the inner workings of EdgewareDAO through a conversation with solo contributor Shankar Warang, which can be [viewed here](https://youtu.be/_wlf9bf9mhY).

Twitter: [https://twitter.com/salmanneedsajob](https://twitter.com/salmanneedsajob)
Youtube: [https://www.youtube.com/@SalmanNeedsAJob](https://www.youtube.com/@SalmanNeedsAJob)

## Problem statement and Proposed solution

The success and growth of the Polkadot ecosystem depend on attracting talented individuals and teams to build on top of it. However, in India, not many people are aware of the potential of Polkadot and the opportunities it offers. This lack of awareness is what this proposal aims to address.
This proposal will also bring awareness to EdgewareDAO by nature of its support and traffic back to the EdgewareDAO podcast via YouTube cards.
